fresh_research.conclusion: Full-prefix chunk and one-token cached GDN use separate FP32-internal algorithms; last_hidden_state is post-final-norm.
H100 supports the existing FlashInfer prefill backend; Triton is separate. Backend remains FlashInfer in first control.
GDN SSM auto inherits convolution/cache dtype, BF16 for this model. Float32 is an explicit precision change, not the baseline.
USE_HUB_KERNELS=NO can make the intended native HF fallback explicit; no FLA/kernel package installation is authorized.

hypotheses: Concrete confound: native fresh replay compiled with native norms, while incremental verifier was eager with vllm_c/native norms.
Chunk versus recurrent GDN arithmetic and state precision may contribute; not an established cache/index bug.
Weight, exact-prefix, position and row-neighbor checks precede any inference about kernels.

e2e.journey: Score the exact same genuine greedy proposal histories through the existing FrozenTarget and actual pinned native BF16 vLLM API, then compare post-final-norm rows and original shared-head logits.
e2e.preconditions: Verified archive and CPU tests; own fresh physical H10080; live price/cap check; original full pinned weights; no optimizer or test requests; runtime/source guards pass.
e2e.offline: Verify all archive parts/whole SHA; restore only diagnostic tensors; existing parity.errors must reproduce prior reports; compare each HF scored row with native aligned and +/-1 rows without wrapping; exact IDs/positions/dtype/finiteness required.
e2e.data: 48 fixed genuine archived greedy branches plus up to12 current native verifier histories selected by the existing bounded acceptance-class selector. No performance/checkpoint/loss tuning or full-corpus training substitute.
e2e.native_trace_steps: Existing live parity request/check CLI for canonical train/dev requests at stockD4 and stockD8, eager execution; retain actual rejected and corrected-continuation histories, classes and failures.
e2e.hf_steps: Actual FrozenTarget.replay on exact complete prefixes; compare actual teacher.text cached execution: prefix minus4 then4 one-token calls with contiguous positions and the full hybrid cache. Frozen/no-grad, original BF16 head, no backend or attention-policy change.
e2e.native_prefill_steps: Separate compiled and eager /v1/completions cells, exact token-ID prompt,max_tokens1,temp0,seed42,C1,prefixcacheOFF,speculationOFF,FlashInfer GDN,SSMautoBF16. Capture-on all histories; capture-off checks first fixed branch and first current partial-rejection history.
e2e.intentional_difference: Native compilation/eager runtime bundle only in first pair; HF full/cached execution only in the second pair. SSM dtype, model weights, GDN backend and sampling remain fixed. No attribution to one fused operation from this bundle alone.
e2e.expected_results: Exact prefix/position identity and capture-on/off output identity. Report unchanged numeric+exact-argmax gates separately for HF full/cached, HF/native compiled/eager, native compiled/eager, and current incremental verifier. Gate failure is valid diagnostic evidence, not permission to train or loosen tolerances.
e2e.artifacts: Exact public requests, all commands/logs/configs/runtime, source hashes, prefix manifests, raw BF16 tensors, row-neighbor and paired comparison reports, failures, full backup/readback and cleanup receipt in existing multipart archive workflow.
e2e.cleanup: Reserve20min; archive and verify complete readback; explicitly delete only recorded owned UUID and confirm API absence before claiming cleanup. Provider auto-delete2h/$6.60. No active prior lease.

success_claim: Bounded execution-path diagnosis only; no training readiness, acceptance or throughput improvement claim
